Subtracted the first machine's $0.8$ from $1$ instead of the second machine's probability.

questions.solution_text:
$0.8 \times P(\text{second works}) = 0.72$
$P(\text{second works}) = 0.72 \div 0.8$
$= 0.9$
$P(\text{second does not work}) = 1 - 0.9$
$= 0.1$
